entries.02334004740b2234: This is the core business of the group, carried out by consolidated subsidiaries Kiraboshi Bank, Ltd. and UI Bank Co., Ltd. Kiraboshi Bank, with Tokyo and the northeastern part of Kanagawa Prefecture as its main operating area, conducts deposit, lending, trading securities, investment securities, domestic exchange, foreign exchange and trust business, among others. UI Bank, a digital bank, conducts deposit, lending and domestic exchange business, among others, through an app. Ordinary income from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥162,069 million.
